title: Request a proposal for a water system | Aquemi
meta: Tell us the project stage, system type and capacity in L/h. An engineer replies within [response time] with questions or a budget proposal.
headline: Request a proposal
lead: Tell us what stage your project is at, which system you need and how much water, in L/h. An engineer reads every request and replies within [response time].

items: Water grades and the pharmacopoeia you must meet (USP, Ph. Eur., or both)
Required capacity: peak and average demand in L/h, and daily volume
Number and location of points of use, with temperature at each
Feed water source and a recent analysis (conductivity, hardness, chlorine or chloramine, silica, TOC)
Your user requirement specification (URS), if you have one
Site constraints: room size, ceiling height, available power and steam
Target dates: order, FAT, water on site

blocks.intro: Fields marked required are the minimum we need to reply with useful questions. Attach documents by reply email after you submit.

fields.label: Project stage
options: Basic design or URS in preparation
Replacing or expanding an existing system

fields.label: Required capacity
fields.help: Peak demand at points of use. If you know only daily volume, enter it below.

fields.label: Pure Steam capacity
fields.help: Only if you need a Pure Steam generator.

fields.label: Target date for water on site

items.d: An engineer replies within [response time] to confirm scope and ask for missing data.
A call of about [45] minutes with your engineering and validation leads to review demand, feed water and site.
A budget or firm proposal within [number] working days, with a process flow diagram, key specifications, documentation list and schedule.

items.q: We do not have a URS yet. Should we still ask?
items.a: Yes. Many projects start with a budget estimate. We can help you write the requirements once the demand and feed water are known.

items.q: Will you sign an NDA first?
items.a: Yes. Send your non-disclosure agreement and we return it signed before you share drawings.
Only Aquemi engineering and sales staff. We do not share or sell your data. See our privacy notice.

cta.body: Call [phone number], [hours], and ask for an application engineer.
